products.name: Gulnar 3-Piece Embroidered Lawn Suit
products.careInstructions: Gentle cold wash separately. Do not bleach. Dry in shade. Warm iron on reverse.
products.shortDescription: Unstitched three-piece lawn with tonal thread work and a printed chiffon dupatta.
products.description: Gulnar is our love letter to the Punjabi summer garden. The shirt is a premium cotton lawn with dense tonal embroidery across the front, finished with a hand-finished neckline and scalloped sleeves. A printed chiffon dupatta and dyed trouser complete the three-piece set. Unstitched, so you can cut it to your own silhouette — we recommend a straight kurta with cigarette pants, or an A-line silhouette with a organza finish.

products.name: Meher Chikankari Cotton Kurta
products.fabric: Soft cotton mul with chikankari-style embroidery
products.careInstructions: Hand wash in cold water. Line dry. Iron on low heat.
products.shortDescription: A breathable everyday kurta with delicate white-on-white embroidery.
products.description: Meher is the kurta you reach for on a Lahore afternoon — soft cotton mul, a relaxed straight cut and delicate chikankari-inspired embroidery at the yoke and hem. Side slits and three-quarter sleeves keep it easy. Pair with white trousers and kolhapuri chappal, or wear it as a short kurta over jeans.

products.name: Noor Formal Chiffon Suit
products.fabric: Embroidered chiffon with raw silk lining and organza dupatta
products.careInstructions: Dry clean only. Store on a padded hanger. Steam lightly.
products.shortDescription: A hand-embellished formal three-piece for weddings and Eid evenings.
products.description: Noor is made for the shaadi season: a deep-toned chiffon shirt with hand-embellished neckline and cuffs, a raw silk trouser and an organza dupatta edged with hand-finished scallops. The embroidery is worked in antique gold and tonal sequins, kept intentionally restrained so the silhouette does the talking. Comes with an inner lining and is fully stitched.

products.name: Sahiba Printed Lawn Set
products.careInstructions: Cold machine wash on a gentle cycle. Wash dark colours separately.
products.shortDescription: A cheerful two-colour print on airy lawn, with a matching printed dupatta.
products.description: Sahiba is a wearable take on the classic Pakistani floral print. The shirt is a soft cotton lawn in a two-colour block print, with a contrasting border and a matching printed dupatta. Unstitched three-piece, with a dyed cambric trouser. Easy to stitch as a straight kurta or a short frock — both work beautifully.

products.name: Zoya Embroidered Abaya
products.careInstructions: Hand wash cold. Do not wring. Hang to dry.
products.shortDescription: A fluid nida abaya with tone-on-tone embroidery and a matching hijab.
products.description: Zoya is cut from soft Korean nida that falls beautifully without clinging. The front panel carries tone-on-tone floral embroidery, and the cuffs are finished with a fine satin trim. It comes with a matching hijab and has hidden side pockets. Designed as a modest, everyday abaya that works equally well for Jummah and evening visits.

products.name: Rafiq Wash & Wear Kurta
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold. Non-iron finish. Do not bleach.
products.shortDescription: The everyday menswear staple — crisp, non-iron and cut for Pakistani summers.
products.description: Rafiq is a classic straight-cut kurta in a breathable poly-cotton wash & wear. It holds a press through a long day, resists creasing and needs almost no ironing. A clean placket, band collar and side pockets keep it practical. Cut slightly longer than a standard shirt, with a straight hem. Wear it to the office, Jummah or a family dinner.

products.name: Kamal Khaddar Waistcoat
products.careInstructions: Dry clean recommended. Brush gently between wears.
products.shortDescription: A structured khaddar waistcoat with a subtle self-texture — festive without fuss.
products.description: Kamal is a five-button waistcoat in handloom khaddar, with a soft cotton lining and a clean, collarless neckline. The fabric has a natural slub that catches the light; the cut is slightly tapered at the waist. Layer it over a white kurta for Eid, or over a dark shirt for an evening dinner. Two welt pockets, one inner pocket.

products.name: Shahzad Everyday Cotton Kurta
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold. Tumble dry low. Warm iron.
products.shortDescription: A soft, breathable cotton kurta for everyday wear.
products.description: Shahzad is the plain cotton kurta we keep coming back to. Light enough for June, substantial enough for air-conditioned offices, with a relaxed straight cut and a simple band collar. It softens with every wash. Pair with shalwar, trousers or jeans — it is quietly versatile.

products.name: Pashm Pashmina-Blend Shawl
products.careInstructions: Dry clean only. Store folded with a muslin cloth.
products.shortDescription: Feather-light warmth with a hand-finished fringe, woven in the northern valleys.
products.description: Pashm is a generously sized pashmina-blend shawl woven on traditional looms in Gilgit-Baltistan. It is light enough to fold into a bag but warm enough for a December evening in Islamabad. The weave has a soft, slightly brushed hand and the edges are finished with a hand-twisted fringe. A quiet heirloom piece.

products.name: Ajrak Handwoven Shawl
products.careInstructions: Hand wash separately in cold water. Dry in shade.
products.shortDescription: A modern weight ajrak, block-printed by hand in Sindh.
products.description: Our ajrak is made with a family of block printers in Bhit Shah, using natural dyes and carved wooden blocks. The traditional maroon, indigo and white motifs are printed on a soft cotton-silk that drapes well as a shawl or a generous dupatta. Each piece carries slight irregularities — the signature of hand block printing. Colours may transfer slightly on first wash.

products.name: Resham Silk Dupatta
products.careInstructions: Dry clean only. Keep away from perfume and moisture.
products.shortDescription: A fluid art-silk dupatta with a fine zari border — an easy festive finish.
products.description: Resham is a lightweight art-silk dupatta with a fine gold zari border and a soft, liquid drape. It is the piece that turns a plain kurta into an outfit — wear it over ivory for Eid, or add it to a dark suit for a mehndi. Generous 2.5 metre length, finished with hand-rolled edges.

products.name: Multani Hand-Embroidered Khussa
products.fabric: Full-grain leather with silk thread embroidery
products.careInstructions: Wipe with a soft dry cloth. Store in the dust bag provided.
products.shortDescription: Hand-embroidered leather khussa from a third-generation Multan workshop.
products.description: Our khussa is made by a small workshop in Multan that has been stitching leather footwear for three generations. The upper is full-grain leather, embroidered by hand with silk thread in a traditional floral motif, and lined with soft goat leather. The sole is flexible leather with a rubber grip patch. It runs true to size; if you are between sizes, size up.

products.name: Peshawari Leather Chappal
products.careInstructions: Condition with leather cream occasionally. Avoid soaking.
products.shortDescription: The original Peshawari chappal — sturdy, hand-stitched and made to last.
products.description: A proper Peshawari chappal, hand-stitched from thick full-grain leather with a moulded leather sole and rubber heel. It starts firm and moulds to your foot over a week of wear. The double strap and brass buckle are classic Khyber craftsmanship. Wear with shalwar kameez, jeans or a linen suit — it has earned its place in every wardrobe.

products.name: Velvet Mehrab Prayer Rug
products.fabric: Dense velvet pile with foam padding
products.careInstructions: Vacuum gently. Spot clean. Do not machine wash.
products.shortDescription: A soft, padded prayer rug with a classic mehrab arch.
products.description: Our mehrab prayer rug is made from a dense, soft velvet pile over a padded foam core, so it cushions knees and forehead through longer prayers. The arch is framed with a traditional border in tonal thread. Generous 110 × 70 cm size. Folds flat for storage and comes with a matching carry band.

products.name: Foldable Travel Prayer Rug
products.careInstructions: Wipe clean. Air dry fully before folding.
products.shortDescription: A light, foldable mat that fits in a tote or car door.
products.description: Designed for travel, this prayer mat folds into a compact rectangle with a zip band and weighs under 500 grams. The surface is a soft, water-resistant polyester; the base is non-slip. It opens to a full 105 × 65 cm. Keep one in the car, the office drawer and your hand luggage.

products.name: Truck Art Cushion Cover Set
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold inside out. Do not tumble dry.
products.shortDescription: Two canvas cushion covers printed with Lahore-style truck art florals.
products.description: A pair of 45 × 45 cm cushion covers printed with the exuberant florals and birds of Pakistani truck art. The base is a heavy cotton canvas with a concealed zip and piped edge. Sold as a set of two covers (inserts not included). Colours are printed to resist fading. A small, joyful nod to the road.

products.name: Sindhi Ralli Handmade Quilt
products.careInstructions: Dry clean or gentle hand wash. Dry flat in shade.
products.shortDescription: A hand-pieced Sindhi ralli quilt, made over several weeks by artisan women.
products.description: Ralli is a traditional Sindhi patchwork textile, hand-pieced from offcuts of cotton fabric and quilted with running stitches. Ours is made by a women's cooperative near Hyderabad and takes several weeks to complete. Each quilt is unique; the geometric pattern and colour placement will vary slightly from the photograph. Size: 220 × 180 cm, with a cotton filling. A functional heirloom for a bed or a reading chair.

products.name: Multan Blue Pottery Vase
products.careInstructions: Wipe with a damp cloth. Handle with care. Not dishwasher safe.
products.shortDescription: A hand-painted Multan blue pottery vase, glazed and fired in a traditional kiln.
products.description: Multan's blue pottery is made from a quartz-based clay body, hand-painted with cobalt and turquoise oxides, then glazed and fired. This medium vase stands 26 cm tall and is decorated with a repeating floral vine. Each piece is painted freehand, so the pattern varies slightly. Use it for dried stems or as a standalone object on a console.

products.name: Jhumka Silver-Plated Earrings
products.careInstructions: Keep away from water and perfume. Wipe with the cloth provided.
products.shortDescription: Classic dome jhumkas with a soft pearl drop, made for festive evenings.
products.description: A pair of traditional dome jhumkas in silver-plated brass, finished with a tiny faux-pearl drop and a comfortable post closure. Light enough for long evenings, with a gentle movement. Nickel-free posts. Presented in a cotton pouch — ready to gift.

products.name: Handwoven Jute Storage Basket
products.fabric: Handwoven natural jute with cotton lining
products.careInstructions: Dust with a soft brush. Keep dry.
products.shortDescription: A sturdy, handwoven jute basket with a removable cotton lining.
products.description: A generous 35 × 30 cm storage basket, handwoven from natural jute by artisans in Punjab. It has a removable, washable cotton lining and two sturdy handles. Use it for laundry, toys, magazines or a very good-looking plant pot. The natural fibre will soften with age.

reviews.title: Beautiful embroidery, true to colour
reviews.body: Ordered from Karachi and received in three days. The lawn is soft and the embroidery is neat — much better than suits I have paid more for. The dupatta print is gorgeous in person.

reviews.title: Lovely suit, slightly deep colour
reviews.body: Quality is very good and stitching was easy. The emerald is a little deeper than the website photo, but still beautiful. Would order again.

reviews.title: The real thing
reviews.body: You can smell the leather and the embroidery is hand-done. I wore them to a mehndi and got so many compliments. Size 38 fit exactly.

reviews.title: So soft and warm
reviews.body: Took it to Murree in December and it was perfect. Light in the bag but genuinely warm. Packaging was lovely too.

reviews.title: Comfortable and well padded
reviews.body: The padding makes a real difference for Fajr. Colour is rich and it folds neatly. Delivery to Islamabad was quick.

reviews.title: Great everyday kurta
reviews.body: Fabric is light and really doesn't need ironing. I ordered beige and white. The white is slightly sheer, so wear a vest underneath.

reviews.title: A proper heirloom
reviews.body: The stitching and patchwork are beautiful. It is heavier than I expected in a good way. Worth every rupee.

reviews.title: Light and pretty
reviews.body: Wore them all night at a wedding and they didn't hurt my ears. The pearl drop is small and delicate. Lovely gift pouch.

reviews.title: Authentic ajrak
reviews.body: The block print has that slight irregularity you only get by hand. I bought one for my mother and ended up ordering another for myself.

reviews.title: Sturdy and comfortable
reviews.body: Took a few days to break in, as expected. Now they are my default footwear. Leather quality is excellent.

reviews.title: Colours are so joyful
reviews.body: Put them on our sofa in the lounge and they instantly brightened the room. Zip quality is good and the canvas is thick.

reviews.title: Even prettier in person
reviews.body: The blue is deep and the hand-painting is lovely. Arrived very well packed — double boxed with foam.
